description.narrative: Mind the Gap in Turkey through Visual Stories of Discrimination, Polarization and Pluralism: The organization's purpose is to implement projects that focus on pluralism, freedom of expression, gender equality and anti-discrimination in Turke. With the Consulates support, TEKHNE wants increase the visibility of discrimination and polarization that the citizens of Turkey face on a daily basis.
